contracts.claim: Each append has sequential identity and previous hash, its digest covers its payload, durable bytes equal emitted bytes, and streamed output uses those same bytes.
The verification observer reads the whole durable chain and refuses JSON, payload digest, previous-hash and sequence corruption.
Goal creation and heartbeat preserve the requested milestones, goal identity and checks, store exact transition fields, and append an identical durable event in the same transaction.
Completing a goal requires a receipt path; successful completion stores the exact receipt and terminal state, removes its due time, and appends the completion event.
The due observer returns only scheduled active goals whose next due time is no later than this observation.
Pairing stores only the salted token digest with exact approved scopes; token and returned device secret are absent from durable rows.
A serialized redeem checks expiry, revocation and token digest, then creates exactly one device with inherited target/scopes and only the salted device-secret digest.
Authentication succeeds exactly for a matching secret, an active device and required scope; revoked devices fail authentication.
Pairing creation rejects unknown device targets and scopes before any durable write.
Automatic resource mode follows observed physical-memory thresholds, preserves verification turns, serializes eco specialists and reserves larger context for memory-rich hosts.
Resource mode accepts the documented aliases including low consumption and max and refuses unrecognized modes.
The bounded capsule chooses ordered specialist roles and honors their model/effort overrides; only executor routes may receive mutation authority.
Starting and finishing children preserves exact parent/child lineage and plan hash in SQLite; terminal receipt bytes and status equal durable registry state, including failure.
Receipt acceptance requires matching lineage, completed status, route authority, nonempty output and matching output digest; pleasant prose cannot override a failure.
A hook configuration accepts only a nonempty string argv list, supported event and bounded timeout; shell strings are refused and processes launch with shell=False.
A mutating hook without parent authority is not executed and receives an approval_required failure receipt.
Each hook action persists its exact result with a content hash; normal completion agrees with the real process exit code.
Usage receipts normalize absent optional cache fields while retaining actual token observations.
Only completed audited runs qualify as learning observations; failed or unaudited attempts preserve their failure state.
Observational recommendations require the sample floor and never execute or promote themselves.
A failing verification receipt cannot be reported as audited success even when files changed.
A requested worktree delta must exist before audit success can be issued.
Repository manual-proof commands are automatically discovered and run as real bounded argv processes with their actual exit status.
Captured manifest bytes and content-addressed blobs match the actual selected workspace entries.
Checkpoint paths and recovery journals must remain inside the selected workspace and may not redirect writes through symlinks.
Restore mutation requires explicit human authority and otherwise leaves workspace contents intact.
Restore validates its complete selected entries and before-image before changing workspace files.
Successful restoration matches captured entries and persists the exact restore receipt.
Incomplete staged transactions are recovered from their confined durable before-image before a new restore begins.
A real write failure restores changed entries to their before-image and records whether the workspace is safe; unchanged locked entries need no rewrite.
Compact MCP denies mutating and unknown calls and rechecks deferred calls at invocation.
Compact MCP exposes only its read-only allowlist while progressive search remains callable.
Paired device credentials and advertised capabilities gate command requests and claims; advertisements contain no provider secrets.
Command authority requires explicit human confirmation bound to the exact device, action, arguments and actor/session/run; approval is consumed once.
A repeated idempotency identity may observe its original exact command but may not change its request or mint authority.
Before delivery, claims recheck durable authority, capability and pairing revocation and reject legacy unbound rows.
Only one live claim per device is permitted and duplicate claims do not duplicate delivery.
Command completion persists its actual result and exact lifecycle projection without inventing remote execution evidence.
Cancellation respects lifecycle authority and prevents later delivery of a cancelled queued command.
Expired claimed delivery remains uncertain and is never silently replayed; a late completion cannot revive authority.
A command never outlives its human authority; its claim lease never outlives the command, and expiry is enforced on observation.
Device request/result payloads reject secret-bearing fields and durable state stores only secret/idempotency digests.
Operator authority loads only an explicitly pinned Ed25519 public verifier outside the mutable workspace and reports readiness truthfully.
Approval requires a valid external signature over the exact canonical transaction; unsigned approval, replay, JSON type changes and unsigned denial fail closed.
Device delivery re-verifies persisted operator authority against current durable approval rather than trusting stored status flags.
The signing wire binds displayed summary, canonical signing bytes, digest and exact approval context; edited fields are rejected.
A lost acknowledgement may retry the same recorded signature but cannot create another approval authority.
Every Native tool call stores its exact named arguments and returned result with a digest-bound durable receipt.
Native catalog/search/describe projections agree with actual tool specifications, availability and authority properties.
Workspace read/search observe only selected contained files and return exact bounded contents and digest.
Tool arguments are JSON objects whose typed values, required fields, defaults and extra-field policy satisfy the selected specification before dispatch.
Explicit CODEX_HOME resolves within that skills root; authorized revision preserves original bytes, writes actual revised content and verifies the version receipt.
Native proposal routing preserves typed target and arguments, mutation policy, preview URLs and inspiration queries.
Preview inspection returns observed bounded HTTP content with its actual status and digest.
Browser annotation requires nonempty real capture artifacts and persists exact W3C-compatible annotation geometry and metadata.
Inspiration queries preserve requested surface/platform/style and board assembly faithfully preserves observed provider image results without fabricating freshness.
A persistent browser worker reuses its actual browser runtime, creates fresh page contexts, reports real counters and closes owned browser resources on shutdown.
